Legion Hold is the apparent main forward base of the Burning Legion in Outland. It is ruled by Deathbringer Jovaan, a man'ari eredar, who receives his orders from a superior eredar commander through a hologram device. The Hold is a giant factory for fel reavers and infernals that boost the ranks of the Legion in Outland. There are few fel orcs loyal to the Legion, doomguards, mo'arg engineers, shivarra, and lots of fel reavers and infernals. The pit lords Makazradon and Morgroron also reside here, as well as the shivarra Prophetess Cavrylin. It is here that the mighty Doomwalker was created.

Legion's Rest is a medium sized cave found directly southwest of Nespirah in Shimmering Expanse. Claimed by the Horde this cavern is where many of the survivors from Nespirah are taken, along with the adventurer while escaping before Nespirah's bio-defenses kill everything inside her. When the group decides to make a forward base in the Ruins of Vashj'ir so that the naga don't discover the cave, many of them leave to the new post. However, after being defeated they eventually return to cavern, except for Captain Vilethorn who is killed in an attack at the forward post.
